rules.artifactAuthority: validated S3 object referenced by Neon fingerprint
rules.queueAuthority: delivery only; queue emptiness never indicates completion
rules.counterRule: increment only when a task changes from nonterminal to its first terminal state
rules.generationFence: every task, message, object key, and write carries runId plus generation
rules.publicationRule: final records and resultsAvailable change in one Neon transaction

boundaries.durableState: task pending or processing under a current lease; no terminal artifact
boundaries.safeRetry: reclaim only after the owner/lease is absent or expired, then repeat bounded work

boundaries.durableState: no proven result; paid DataForSEO ledger may be in_flight/ambiguous
boundaries.safeRetry: DataForSEO becomes ambiguous and is not automatically repeated; idempotent/read-only providers may retry within their explicit budget
boundaries.deduplicationKey: provider request fingerprint plus task key
boundaries.fence: paid ledger lease; source-specific work lease
boundaries.terminalState: ambiguous or retryable source failure, never synthesized success

boundaries.durableState: task is nonterminal and no artifact is authoritative
boundaries.safeRetry: repeat local serialization; repeat external call only under the source-specific ambiguity rule

boundaries.durableState: object may or may not exist; Neon task remains nonterminal
boundaries.safeRetry: HEAD/read the deterministic key; accept only the expected fingerprint, otherwise create with If-None-Match or report conflict

boundaries.durableState: an object already occupies the deterministic key
boundaries.safeRetry: same fingerprint is an idempotent replay; a different fingerprint is a terminal invariant conflict

boundaries.durableState: validated artifact exists; task remains nonterminal
boundaries.safeRetry: reconcile the object fingerprint and commit the first terminal transition without repeating provider work
boundaries.fence: task state transition and lease token

boundaries.durableState: task terminal and stage count already incremented once
boundaries.safeRetry: observe the identical terminal record and emit another aggregation-check message

boundaries.durableState: task terminal; one or more aggregation checks may exist
boundaries.safeRetry: send/check again; only one aggregator can acquire the Neon aggregation lease
boundaries.alarm: none for harmless duplicate; alarm on stale aggregation lease

boundaries.durableState: Neon contains the only accepted task state and count
boundaries.safeRetry: validate generation and fingerprint; replay or reject without a second count increment

boundaries.durableState: last committed task/artifact/ledger state survives; in-memory progress is discarded
boundaries.safeRetry: SQS redelivery plus expired-lease reclaim and artifact/ledger reconciliation
boundaries.alarm: Lambda timeout, age of oldest message, lease expiry

boundaries.durableState: successful records may be terminal while failed records remain retryable
boundaries.safeRetry: return only failed message identifiers through ReportBatchItemFailures

boundaries.durableState: stage is created with expectedCount=0 and terminalCount=0 in ready state
boundaries.safeRetry: emit/check aggregation normally; do not infer completion from absent messages

boundaries.durableState: run cancellation and generation fence are durable in Neon
boundaries.safeRetry: late workers stop before external calls and cannot commit artifacts/tasks/publication for the cancelled generation
boundaries.fence: cancelled run state, generation, lease token

boundaries.durableState: message retained in DLQ; task/run state remains the source of truth
boundaries.safeRetry: operator inspects safe error and durable state, fixes cause, then redrives a bounded message set
boundaries.fence: same generation and normal task claims
boundaries.alarm: DLQ visible message count greater than zero

boundaries.durableState: intermediate leads/traffic may exist, but resultsAvailable remains false
boundaries.safeRetry: aggregation owner retries the single publication transaction under its lease
boundaries.fence: aggregation token and active run generation

boundaries.durableState: final records, result fingerprint, completed state, and resultsAvailable=true committed atomically
boundaries.safeRetry: same manifest fingerprint is an idempotent replay; a different fingerprint is rejected
boundaries.fence: terminal run state and final fingerprint
